observations: body L1-L4: the Syriac is printed in a West Syriac (Serto) type with West Syriac vowel signs: the pṯāḥā (Greek alpha, printed like a four-armed figure) on «ܗܰܘ» (twice), «ܡܬܟܰܢܐ» and «ܕܢܳܒܰܚ», the zqāpā (Greek omicron with a tail) on «ܒܗܳܝ» (twice), «ܕܢܳܒܰܚ» and «ܥܳܪܒ»; the zqāpā on «ܣܳܠܩ» is printed open at the top (like y).
body L3: «ܡܬܗܓܓ» is printed so, with two gamals (the second in its final form).
body L9, L19: the iota of «ὑπόκιῤῥος» (L9) and of «βασιλίσκος» (L19) is printed broken (like «:»).
body L16, L31: «dans» is printed with the a broken; a speck is printed above the S of «Sirio» and after the S of «Schjellerupi» (L31); not transcribed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
